meta.title: Book in Cambodia
meta.description: Find any book in Cambodia: see which bookstores, libraries and sellers have it, or order it from abroad. A free, non-profit, open source directory.

home.badge: Non-profit · Free for everyone · Open source
home.lead: Search once and see every store, library and seller that has it.
home.howLead: Three steps from "I want this book" to holding it.
home.step1Text: By title, author or ISBN, in English or Khmer.
home.step2Title: See where it is in Cambodia
home.step2Text: Bookstores, second-hand sellers and libraries, with price and contact.
home.step3Text: Contact a book-buying service that brings it in for you.
home.categoriesLead: From Khmer classics to learning English.

faq.a: No. We show you which stores, sellers and libraries have a book, and you contact them directly. We never take a commission.

faq.q: Is it free to list my bookstore?
faq.a: Yes, always. Every store is listed free and equally, and nobody can pay to be shown first.

faq.q: How up to date are prices and stock?
faq.a: Each listing shows when it was last checked. Listings older than six months are marked as possibly outdated, so contact the store to confirm.
Add books you see in stores, check store details, translate pages into Khmer, or help build the site on GitHub.

home.ctaText: Book-buying services can order it from abroad and deliver it to you here. Or tell us which book you're looking for.

stores.ownStoreText: Help readers find you. Add your store, your contact and the books you sell. No fees, ever.

abroad.lead: Can't find a book in Cambodia? These services order books from other countries and deliver them to you here.
abroad.step1Text: Message a service on Telegram or Facebook.
abroad.step2Text: Book price, shipping and service fee.
abroad.disclaimer: Book in Cambodia doesn't sell books, handle payments or take commissions. Services are listed free by the community; agree on price and delivery with them directly.

about.title: About
about.contactText: Questions, corrections or partnership ideas: email {email}.

footer.about: A non-profit, volunteer-run home for book lovers in Cambodia. We don't sell books, take commissions or show ads. Every store is listed free and equally.

contribute.title: Help
contribute.lead: Everything here comes from readers, stores and volunteers. Pick how you would like to help.
contribute.requestText: Looking for a book nobody lists yet? Tell us, so stores and volunteers know people want it.
contribute.addListingTitle: Say where to buy a book
contribute.addListingText: Seen a book in a store or library? Add where, the price and the date.
contribute.addStoreText: Know a place that sells or lends books? Add it. Listing is free, always.
contribute.addServiceText: Run or know a service that orders books from abroad?
contribute.reportText: Wrong price, closed store, broken link or a translation mistake? Let us know.
contribute.githubNote: GitHub needs a free account. No account? Use Telegram, the form or email.
contribute.editorsText: Regular contributors can edit books, stores and services directly in the browser. Every change is reviewed before it goes live.
contribute.codeText: Designers, developers and translators: the website is open source.
contribute.reportPage: Report a problem with this page
contribute.noGithub: No GitHub account? More ways to help
contribute.eventText: A book fair, reading, author talk or swap? List it for free.
contribute.clubText: Run or join a reading group? Add it so others can find it.
contribute.donationTitle: Add a place that needs books
contribute.donationText: A library, school or book drive that welcomes donated books?

principles.title: No ads, no commissions
principles.text: We never take a cut from stores or import services.

principles.title: Every listing is free and equal
principles.text: No one can pay to be shown first.

principles.text: Anyone can reuse the catalog and the code.

principles.title: Run by volunteers
principles.text: Readers, stores and librarians keep the information up to date.

donate.lead: Places that welcome donated books. Check what they need before you bring them.
donate.add: Need books for your library or school? Get listed
tips: Only give books in good condition: clean, complete, readable.
Ask first. Many libraries need specific books, like Khmer picture books.
Books in Khmer are almost always the most wanted.
